thread:
alex_g: Hey infra team — requesting quota/project approvals to onboard a new hybrid inference pool (project: redwood-ml-proj-asia-eu). Need increases below across asia-southeast1 and europe-west3 so we can launch customer-dedicated H100/L4 capacity on day-0. Details: H100 (a2-highgpu) x 8 -> request increase to 24 GPUs total, L4 (a2-ultragpu equivalent) x 16 -> request increase to 64, External IPs (regional static) +20, Egress quota +5 Tb/month. Start target: 2026-04-15. Business justification: dedicated private capacity for 2 enterprise customers (SLA-backed), predictable throughput. Estimated monthly committed spend ~ $95k if fully utilized. Billing acct: billing-redwood-prod (CC-42 pending). Service account: sa-inference@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. KMS key in project for customer data. Please advise next steps and approvals needed.

maria_s: Thanks Alex. Can you confirm the exact zones (asia-southeast1-a/b, europe-west3-a/b?) and whether these are preemptible or sustained instances? Also we need the current quota outputs (gcloud compute regions get-quota or console screenshot) so we can attach to the GCP support case. H100 increases often need GCP engagement — I'll escalate if you include expected start date and peak QPS.

jonathan_d: Networking note — adding external IPs + egress bump means we should plan VPC peering and route quotas. Are these instances going to sit in our shared-prod VPC or a customer-dedicated VPC? If shared-prod, we'll need to check subnetwork IP capacity and any Cloud NAT rules. Also confirm whether NAT egress will hit egress quotas for Partner X endpoints.

karen_ops: From finance: we need a line-item monthly estimate (broken down by GPU hours and network egress) and confirmation of cost center before we sign off. CC-42 OK but need PO or internal ticket for chargeback. Also we prefer reserved capacity commitments over on-demand if this is long-term.

security_anna: Quick security checklist: will customer data be processed in these VMs? If yes, we need KMS key rotation policy, IAM principals limited to sa-inference, and an internal brief for Data Protection review. We also need to know if any data residency constraints require EU-only placement.

alex_g: Answers:
- Zones: asia-southeast1-a,b (primary), europe-west3-a,b (secondary).
- Instance policy: mix — sustained for L4 (non-preemptible), H100 burst pool will be non-preemptible for SLAs.
- Workload: inference only, models loaded from internal artifact registry; some customer inputs may be PII -> security review required.
- Cost breakout (rough): GPU runtime $70k/mo, network egress $15k/mo, misc infra $10k/mo -> ~ $95k/mo. We'll explore 6/12 month reserved commit if approved.
- I'll attach gcloud outputs in a sec and open the GCP ticket.

enginfra_bot: Quick quota snapshot (requested by maria_s):
```

metric: GPUS_ALL_REGIONS, limit: 8, usage: 0
$ gcloud compute regions describe europe-west3 --project=redwood-ml-proj-asia-eu --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS_ALL_REGIONS")'
metric: GPUS_ALL_REGIONS, limit: 12, usage: 4
```
(placeholder — please run from your account to validate)

maria_s: OK. Alex, please open a GCP support case with the following fields filled: project id, exact quota deltas per region, billing account, justification, anticipated month-1 hours, and contact email. Put me on the CC and tag eng-infra. I'll flag H100 as high-priority with GCP.

alex_g: Filed the support case — https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CASE-2026-12345 (internal link). Added all details and attached the quota snapshot. Asking for H100 escalation. Also added proposed labels: env:dedicated, pool:d-ex1, team:inference.

gcp-support-bot: GCP support case CASE-2026-12345 created. Current status: OPEN. Estimated response: 48-72h due to resource availability. Case owner: gcp.eng@google.com

jonathan_d: I'll prep VPC peering and check subnetwork IP availability this afternoon. If we need new /22 ranges we'll request from net-ops. Also will coordinate Cloud NAT rules and update routing.

karen_ops: Finance sign-off pending PO. If commit is approved, finance can approve CC-42 for initial spend up to $120k/month. Please create an internal PO request and tag me.

security_anna: I'll schedule a 30-min review with Alex and Maria tomorrow to confirm KMS/IAM and data retention. Please add any prompt examples that contain PII so we can evaluate redaction needs.

maria_s: Approving go-ahead for filing and escalation. Final approval for quota increases contingent on: (1) PO/chargeback assigned, (2) security brief completed, (3) VPC addressing plan. Once those are in place I'll stamp it and call GCP account team to fast-track H100.

alex_g: Thanks all — I'll: (1) open the internal PO ticket and tag karen_ops, (2) add prompt samples for security, (3) post the VPC addressing plan here by EOD. Will update thread when GCP responds.

maria_s: 👌 will follow up with GCP account team after security brief.

jonathan_d: noted, will update when subnets/peering created.

karen_ops: 👍 once PO is in, I'll approve the cost center chargeback.

alex_g: Thanks :thumbsup:
